ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Emerging Programming Paradigms. A new generation of applications is changing the nature of programming with the need for scalability, parallelism, distribution, and mobility. Moreover, web applications require context awareness; cloud computing requires balancing availability, consistency and reliability; sensor networks use broadcast messages and have limited computational resources; and cyberphysical systems must also specify real-time control. The course will cover actor languages and related programming paradigms to address these challenges.
